AdminChanged(address,address).details: Emitted when the admin account has changed.

BeaconUpgraded(address).details: Emitted when the beacon is upgraded.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

batchApproveRegistration(uint256[],bytes.details: This gets called by the Oracle and only when it has confirmed the withdraw credentials of the 1 ETH deposit in the registration         phase match the withdraw credentials stored on the beacon chain. This prevents a front-running attack.

params._pubKey: The pubKey for each validator being spun up.
params._signature: The signatures for each validator for the 31 ETH transaction that were emitted in the register phase
params._validatorIds: The IDs of the validators to be approved

batchCancelDeposit(uint256[]).details: This is called only in the BNFT player flow

batchDepositAsBnftHolder(uint256[],uint2.details: This function has multiple dependencies that need to be followed before this function will succeed.

params._candidateBidIds: validator IDs that have been matched with the BNFT holder on the FE
params._numberOfValidators: how many validators the user wants to spin up. This can be less than the candidateBidIds length.          we may have more Ids sent in than needed to spin up incase some ids fail.
params._validatorIdToShareSafeWith: The validator ID of the validator that the user wants to shafe the withdrawal safe with

returns._0: Array of bids that were successfully processed.

batchRegisterAsBnftHolder(bytes32,uint25.details: This function can only be called by a BNFT player on IDs that have been deposited.

params._depositDataRootApproval: The deposit data roots for each validator for the 31 ETH transaction which will happen in the approval         step. See the Staking Manager for details.
params._depositRoot: This is the deposit root of the beacon chain. Can send in 0x00 to bypass this check in future
params._registerValidatorDepositData: As in the solo staking flow, the BNFT player must send in a deposit data object (see ILiquidityPool for struct data)         to register the validators. However, the signature and deposit data root must be for a 1 ETH deposit
params._signaturesForApprovalDeposit: Much like the deposit data root. This is the signature for each validator for the 31 ETH          transaction which will happen in the approval step.
params._validatorIds: The ids of the validators to register

params._bNftHolder: Address of the BNFT player to remove

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params._protocolFees: The amount of protocol fees to pay in ether

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

params._user: The address of the BNFT player to register

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

requestMembershipNFTWithdraw(address,uin.details: Transfers the amount of eETH from MembershipManager to the WithdrawRequestNFT contract & mints an NFT to the recipient

params.amount: requested amount to withdraw from contract
params.fee: the burn fee to be paid by the recipient when the withdrawal is claimed (WithdrawRequestNFT.claimWithdraw)
params.recipient: address that will be issued the NFT

requestWithdraw(address,uint256).details: Transfers the amount of eETH from msg.senders account to the WithdrawRequestNFT contract & mints an NFT to the msg.sender

params.amount: requested amount to withdraw from contract
params.recipient: address that will be issued the NFT

requestWithdrawWithPermit(address,uint25.details: accepts PermitInput signed data to approve transfer of eETH (EIP-2612) so withdraw request can happen in 1 tx

params._amount: requested amount to withdraw from contract
params._owner: address that will be issued the NFT
params._permit: signed permit data to approve transfer of eETH

params._treasury: The address to set as the treasury

sharesForWithdrawalAmount(uint256).details: withdrawal rounding errors favor the protocol by rounding up

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._address: the new address to set as admin

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

withdraw(address,uint256).details: Burns user share from msg.senders account & Sends equivalent amount of ETH back to the recipient

params._amount: the amount to withdraw from contract it returns the amount of shares burned
params._recipient: the recipient who will receives the ETH

batchApproveRegistration(uint256[],bytes.notice: Approves validators and triggers the 31 ETH transaction to the beacon chain (rest of the stake).

batchCancelDeposit(uint256[]).notice: Cancels a BNFT players deposits (whether validator is registered or deposited. Just not live on beacon chain)

batchDepositAsBnftHolder(uint256[],uint2.notice: Allows a BNFT player to deposit their 2 ETH and pair with 30 ETH from the LP

batchRegisterAsBnftHolder(bytes32,uint25.notice: BNFT players register validators they have deposited. This triggers a 1 ETH transaction to the beacon chain.

deRegisterBnftHolder(address).notice: Removes a BNFT player from the bnftHolders array

payProtocolFees(uint128).notice: pay protocol fees including 5% to treaury, 5% to node operator and ethfund bnft holders

registerAsBnftHolder(address).notice: The admin can register an address to become a BNFT holder

requestMembershipNFTWithdraw(address,uin.notice: request withdraw of some or all of the eETH backing a MembershipNFT and receive a WithdrawRequestNFT

requestWithdraw(address,uint256).notice: request withdraw from pool and receive a WithdrawRequestNFT

requestWithdrawWithPermit(address,uint25.notice: request withdraw from pool with signed permit data and receive a WithdrawRequestNFT

sendExitRequests(uint256[]).notice: Send the exit requests as the T-NFT holder of the LiquidityPool validators

setRestakeBnftDeposits(bool).notice: Whether or not nodes created via bNFT deposits should be restaked

updateAdmin(address,bool).notice: Updates the address of the admin
